name: Sagawa Takuma
source:
"Wanna do an endurance contest? I don't think I'll lose though lol"

Occupation: Delivery Driver

The most dangerous!? Birth of a malicious stalker

He is a good young man who gives the impression of being diplomatic and vivacious. He was the type of person who used to play around with women back when he was a student, but when he got a job he changed his character to that of a calm older brother.

   He rarely gets angry when there is a trouble and always has a smile on his face, giving the impression that he is calm, but inside he might be thinking of just ending it quickly because of how troublesome it is.

   Because he is athletic-minded as well, his approach to love until now has been "Let's go for it!" and being straightforward without giving you any way out. He treats you kindly with the intention of one-upping you, but if you act indifferent, he becomes so serious he won't give you a way to escape.

   He is not a pure good man because of the ulterior motives that accompany most of his actions, but if you date and get to know him properly he can be a good husband with normal sensibilities, both good and bad.
